## What's new

### Languages
- **Italian, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese** join German and French. Download them from [Moon Keyboard Languages](https://github.com/Moon-Ecosystem/MoonKeyboard-Languages/releases), then open **Languages → Add a language from a file**. Spanish has an ñ key.
- **Holding space with many languages on** wraps their names onto more rows instead of squeezing them together.

### Typing
- **A Symbols button** in the keyboard's options (or on the top bar) turns long-press symbols on and off.
- **The recent emoji row can hold more:** set **Emoji → Emoji in the row** up to 32, and swipe the row to reach them.

### Settings
- **Fewer, clearer screens:** Typing is grouped into Suggestions, Gestures (with glide typing) and Feedback; Look into Theme, Layout and Top bar; and every emoji setting is under Emoji.

### Fixes
- Password-manager suggestions match the keyboard's colours, including pitch black, accent colours and Material You.
- With pitch black on, the accent swatches and the test pad no longer show light-theme colours.
- The status bar follows the app's theme setting, and the app no longer flashes white when it opens in dark mode.
